Both moulded wheels a single stud clear of the plate-grass at the exact instant of lift-off, tuft elements fanned flat in a wide arc behind the tail and a skid line still freshly scored into the green mosaic, the mechanic's sandwich launched skyward from the blast.

The tail-skid carving a long curved groove through the plate-turf as the machine pivots hard on one braked wheel, the arc scored deep into the green mosaic and a startled rabbit minifigure tumbling clear of the sweep.

A hand-prop caught at the very top of its swing, the moulded blade vertical and still, the mechanic minifigure already twisting off his feet with both C-shaped hands flung wide and one boot three studs above the ground, a thermos flask rolling away behind him.

Straining against a tied-tail run-up rope pulled perfectly bar-straight between the tail hook and a wooden stake element bending visibly in the turf, loose tan plate-studs lifting in a fan ahead of the propeller wash, a windsock element snapping rigid sideways.

In the landing flare with the tail dropping and both wheels a stud above the plate-grass, the skid element poised to bite the turf and a brick frog leaping off the runway centerline in a single frozen arc.

Banked steeply low over the hangar ridge with a crewman minifigure lying perfectly flat on the peak, his printed eyes wide and one C-shaped hand pressed to his helmet as the shadow of the lower wing crosses him.

Nose buried gently in a round hay-bale brick with the tail cocked high at a jaunty angle, straw-colored studs sprayed forward across the green mosaic, and three brick cows turning their printed faces slowly to observe with absolute bovine calm.

Tail pitched up and both floats buried in a duck pond of trans-blue plates thrown in a wide fan, brick ducks scattering off the near wingtip with their orange plate-feet still mid-paddle, the pilot minifigure raising both arms overhead.

Nose-down on brick trestles with the cowling hinged open on clip plates, the round-brick engine ring bare to every cylinder, and a brick chicken settled with profound authority on the rocker cover, a tiny egg element placed beside it.

Up on trestles with one wheel completely off, the axle propped on a fuel crate, and the liberated wheel rolling away downhill past a mechanic minifigure lunging after it with one arm outstretched and a wrench still raised in the other.

A lower-wing panel peeled back off the plate frame, the tile-clad leading edge flopped open and exposing the Technic-pin rib structure within, while the dope tin tips off the spar and a golden stream of trans-yellow round plates rains down.

Being towed by a tiny brick tractor with the tow rope snapping suddenly taut and bar-straight, the tractor's front wheels lifting clear of the turf on their axle and the driver minifigure gripping the steering wheel with both C-shaped hands tilted back.

A wing-walker minifigure mid-transfer from the upper-wing rail to the outer strut cage, one Technic-bar hand still gripping the rail and one boot already committed to the strut, her printed face fixed in a grin, a jam jar tucked under one arm.

Snatching a plain pennant off the ground gantry at full speed, the line whipping up taut into the undercarriage bay while the gantry pole rocks forward on its base plate and a marshal minifigure dives flat onto the grass.

Climbing steeply off the strip end with the tail still low, a dense brick bird-flock parting around both wingtips in two curving arcs, one bird element sitting inexplicably on the leading edge riding along with evident satisfaction.

Skimming a brick hedgerow on the take-off hop with the undercarriage a single stud above the top course, and a farmer minifigure below watching his flat cap lift clean off his printed head and tumble into the propeller wash.

At the apex of a slow loop with the cockpit pointing straight down toward the green plate-mosaic below, a trail of white cloud-slope smoke bricks curling behind the tail, and the pilot's goggles element clipped loosely and visibly flapping.

Touching down on floats with a wide fan of trans-blue plates erupting from the keel on the near side over a wooden jetty, the jetty's brick fisherman minifigure throwing his rod into the air and his catch brick arcing free.

Landing on brick skis with white plate-flecks sheeting up in a broad rooster-tail over a waiting dog-sled team, the lead brick dog crouched with ears flat, and the musher minifigure shielding his printed face with one C-shaped hand.

Being winched out of the hangar mouth on a trolley with the tow bar pulling forward and the near wingtip clearing the door frame by exactly one stud, one minifigure spotter at the near wingtip with both arms wide, another further back down the flank.

Dropping a crate on a parachute fabric element over a jungle clearing with the crate still swinging on its rigging bars and trans-green vine elements parting below, a stone idol head at the strip threshold staring up with blank round eyes.

Thundering down the strip abreast of a galloping brick horse with its rider standing tall in the stirrups, the horse's mane elements streaming back, the pilot glancing sideways from the open cockpit with a competitive printed grin.

Pivoting hard round a plain painted pylon cone in a banking turn, the inner wingtip a single stud off the plate-grass, a scatter of tan studs kicked up by the propeller blast, and a race official minifigure gripping his hat with both hands.

Taxiing straight at a wandering brick goose that is refusing to move, the goose element facing forward with serene indifference, and the pilot minifigure half-risen from the cockpit with both C-shaped arms spread in exasperated appeal to the universe.

Lifting a kite on a long clip-and-bar line off the tail hook while two kid minifigures sprint flat-out below gripping the spool, the kite element already a dozen studs high and pulling the line bar-straight behind the climbing tail.
